headword: {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}

definitions.explanation: An increase in the production of goods and services in an economy over time, typically measured by GDP. A fundamental concept in economics and news reporting.

examples.japanese: {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍化|どんか}→鈍化：08000_donka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}{期|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Japan changed dramatically during the period of rapid economic growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{持続|じぞく}{可能|かのう}→持続可能：04637_jizokukanou⟧な{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}する→配慮する：26831_hairyosuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To achieve sustainable economic growth, it is necessary to also consider the environment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (economy) and ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧ (growth). One of the most frequently used terms in Japanese news and economic discussion.

ETYMOLOGY:
Japan's {高度経済成長|こうどけいざいせいちょう} (high economic growth period, roughly 1955-1973) transformed the country from postwar devastation into the world's second-largest economy. This era is a defining reference point in modern Japanese history.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}{率|りつ} — economic growth rate
- ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう} — rapid economic growth
- {経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧ — to achieve economic growth
- ⟦{持続|じぞく}{可能|かのう}→持続可能：04637_jizokukanou⟧な{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう} — sustainable economic growth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧ — economic conditions (broader, includes ups and downs)
- ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧ — development (broader, not limited to economics)
- GDP — gross domestic product (the standard measure)
